images.description: A brand-new free Omi owner's first conversation is processed by the local backend. Left: main builds no push, the locked phone shows nothing. Second: this change, the lock screen shows "Your first summary is ready" with the conversation title. Third: opening it shows that conversation on its Summary tab. Right: reading 3s and going back shows PR #23762's trial page with live prices. The push is the FCM message this branch's backend built, delivered with xcrun simctl push. iPhone 17 Pro simulator.
The other tap path: the app was killed, the same push is opened from the lock screen, and the app launches straight onto the conversation's Summary tab. iPhone 17 Pro simulator.
